# Janmenjaya Biswal — Frontend Developer

> Personal portfolio of Janmenjaya Biswal, a Frontend Developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India, with 3+ years of experience building fast, scalable web applications with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript and React Native.

Janmenjaya currently builds EdTech products for IFAS Educate Pvt. Ltd. (via e2eHiring), and has delivered 4 live production platforms serving 50,000+ learners across India. Janmenjaya's focus is reusable component architecture, REST API integration, performance optimisation and mobile-first responsive UI. Janmenjaya received an Excellence Award for outstanding project performance and holds a GCP Associate Cloud Engineer certification and an MCA from Trident Academy of Creative Technology.
